name: The Walker household at 1721 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_walker_henry_h

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1721 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1721 Mr. & Mrs. Henry H. Walker.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1721, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. In 1900 Henry Gardiner, a school principal, lived here, not the Walkers. The census says nothing about this household's staff. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.
